title: Two numbers to name
prompt: This bill is some items at 4.5 each, plus 20% tax. Name both numbers, `PRICE_PER_ITEM` and `TAX_RATE`, and use the names everywhere. Notice 4.5 appears twice in the starter.
starter:
func bill_with_tax(quantity) -> float:
	return quantity * 4.5 + quantity * 4.5 * 0.2
hints: Replace every copy of each number, not just the first.

docs.name: const NAME = value
docs.what: Declares a named value that never changes. Written in CAPITALS by convention.

solution:
func bill_with_tax(quantity) -> float:
	const PRICE_PER_ITEM = 4.5
	const TAX_RATE = 0.2
	return quantity * PRICE_PER_ITEM + quantity * PRICE_PER_ITEM * TAX_RATE
